requirements.text: The system shall capture attendance data with 100% accuracy for every clock-in and clock-out event recorded.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 explicitly stated 'as long as the system captures the data accurately,' establishing a measurable accuracy target.

requirements.text: As a system administrator, I want the system to integrate with external HR software for employee data synchronization, so that employee records are consistent across systems.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 in c8 asks about integration with 'other systems like payroll or HR software,' and although Spk 1 defers, the need for HR data sync is implied by the access control and reporting requirements.

requirements.text: The system shall log all access to attendance records with user identity and timestamp, so that an audit trail exists for compliance and security reviews.
requirements.rationale: Given attendance data is personal and the system has role-based access, an audit trail is a standard security and compliance requirement to detect unauthorized access or changes.

requirements.text: The system shall encrypt attendance data at rest and in transit, so that personal information is protected against unauthorized disclosure.
requirements.rationale: Attendance records are personal data; encryption is a fundamental security measure to protect privacy and meet regulatory obligations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) even though not explicitly discussed.

requirements.text: As a system administrator, I want to configure data retention policies for attendance records, so that the system complies with legal and company requirements for record keeping.
requirements.rationale: The analyst asked about data retention requirements in c8, and although the stakeholder deferred, this is a legal/compliance necessity that must be addressed.

requirements.text: As a system, I want to accept attendance data from multiple input sources (e.g., web portal, mobile app, physical terminals), so that employees can record attendance via any method.
requirements.rationale: Spk 0 in c0 asks about recording via web, mobile, terminal, or integration; Spk 1 in c1 says 'I don't really care how they clock in' and User Story 2 in c6 says 'capture and store employee attendance data from various sources'.

requirements.text: The system shall reliably capture and store attendance data from multiple sources (e.g., web portal, mobile app, physical terminal, integration) without data loss.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1's indifference to method and Spk 0's listing of sources, combined with User Story 2's 'reliably capture and store from various sources,' imply a reliability requirement for multi-source data ingestion.

requirements.text: As a system, I want to store employee attendance records that include employee identifier, clock-in timestamp, and clock-out timestamp, so that attendance data is captured accurately and can be used for reporting and payroll.
requirements.rationale: Spk 1 states the system must capture data accurately, and the user stories in c6 mention recording clock-in and clock-out times, implying these are the core attributes of an attendance record.

requirements.text: As a system, I want to reliably capture and store employee attendance data from various sources, so that all records are centralized and accurate.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder stated the method doesn't matter as long as data is captured accurately, and this user story was approved.

requirements.text: As an employee, I want to record my clock-in and clock-out times, so that my attendance is accurately tracked.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly approved this user story in the transcript.

requirements.text: As a manager or HR personnel, I want to view team-based attendance trends and reports, so that I can identify broader patterns and make staffing decisions.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly approved this user story.

requirements.text: As a manager, I want to view a daily summary of my team's attendance (e.g., who is present, late, or absent), so that I can manage daily operations effectively.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly approved this user story.

requirements.text: As an HR personnel or executive, I want to view high-level attendance dashboards and analytics, so that I can understand organizational trends and inform policy.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly approved this user story.

requirements.text: As a manager or HR personnel, I want to generate reports that include daily summaries (present, late, absent), individual employee attendance over a period, monthly summaries per employee, team-based trends, and exception reports (e.g., late arrivals, unexcused absences), so that I can manage operations, process payroll, and identify patterns.
requirements.rationale: User stories 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 in c6 explicitly list these report types, defining the data that must be queryable and aggregated.

requirements.text: As an employee, I want to view my own personal attendance history and summaries, so that I can verify my records and plan my time.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly approved this user story.

requirements.text: As a system administrator, I want to define and manage access controls for attendance data, so that information is only visible to authorized users (e.g., specific managers, HR).
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly approved this user story.

requirements.text: As a manager, I want to view an individual employee's attendance record over a selected period, so that I can address patterns or discuss performance.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly approved this user story.

requirements.text: As an HR personnel, I want to generate monthly attendance summaries per employee, so that I can process payroll accurately.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly approved this user story.

requirements.text: As a manager, I want to receive or view exception reports (e.g., for late arrivals or unexcused absences), so that I can take timely corrective action.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly approved this user story.
